CALL FOR PAPERS, REVIEWERS, GUEST EDITORS AND SPECIAL ISSUES FOR BRAIN JOURNAL (ISI -Web of Sciences Indexed Journal). The scholars who want to serve as Guest Editors for a special or normal issue of the BRAIN / Broad Research in Artificial Intelligence and Neuroscience journal are invited to send us a proposal of an issue topic (that should match the general topic of the journal) and a description of the issue (the estimated topics of the articles and the number of articles that are estimated to be published in the issue). The conference organizers in the medical fields related to the topic of the BRAIN / Broad Research in Artificial Intelligence and Neuroscience journal are welcome to submit proposals for special issues that contain meeting extended abstracts/conference proceedings/working papers of a conference.
